selected_hardware_facts.mechanism: Pipelined frontend with queue space admission
selected_hardware_facts.evidence: Frontend module instantiates fq ShiftQueue, s1_valid/s2_valid; s0_fq_has_space reads queue mask bits2,3,4 and stage valids; s0_valid=io.cpu.req.valid OR s0_fq_has_space; icache.io.req.valid=s0_valid.
selected_hardware_facts.implication: Fetch admission can continue from frontend queue capacity without a retired-instruction event.

selected_hardware_facts.evidence: s1_base_pc aligns down to4bytes; ntpc=s1_base_pc+4; predicted_npc defaults to ntpc; replay/BTB redirect paths select nextPC.
selected_hardware_facts.implication: Fetch addresses can include future or ultimately uncommitted instructions. The actual probe path and refills require observation to establish.

selected_hardware_facts.evidence: s2_can_speculatively_refill=s2_tlb_resp.cacheable AND NOT customCSRbit3; icache.s2_kill=(s2_speculative AND NOT permission) OR s2_xcpt. ICache s2_miss=s2_valid AND NOT s2_hit AND NOT io.s2_kill.
selected_hardware_facts.implication: The selected implementation permits speculative cacheable refills under its declared CSR condition; this review does not infer every actual speculative request.

selected_hardware_facts.evidence: ICache response valid=s2_valid AND s2_hit; A-channel valid=s2_request_refill, with block-aligned refill address. Refill availability tracks s2_miss/refill_valid.
selected_hardware_facts.implication: A cache refill is a frontend state transition; its admission is not tied to instruction retirement.

selected_hardware_facts.mechanism: No selected explicit next-line Hint prefetch
selected_hardware_facts.evidence: Elaborated ICache contains reset-only send_hint/hint_outstanding and no connect assignment to enable them; no generated optional next-line Hint branch between default demand Get and refill completion.
selected_hardware_facts.source_annotations: ICache.scala772-808 optional source branch is absent in selected elaboration
selected_hardware_facts.implication: Do not attribute this probe to an enabled next-line Hint prefetcher.

frozen_model_facts.evidence: record_memory ignores FETCH; finish_instruction returns on !committed before fetch handling, then MemorySystem.access uses exactly current pc and2/4 instruction bytes.
frozen_model_facts.implication: There is no independent predicted/wrong-path frontend stream or queue in this observer input.

frozen_model_facts.evidence: Each fetch writes token64; the CPU event reads token64; a branch also writes token64. Engine.submit waits current issue frontier plus read/write dependencies.
frozen_model_facts.implication: Demand fill latency delays its corresponding CPU instruction; subsequent fetches are emitted from committed instruction order and share the global issue frontier.

frozen_model_facts.evidence: For decoded.fence, target.fence and engine.barrier execute BEFORE the fence instruction fetch is modeled. Only decoded.icache_fence invalidates instruction cache.
frozen_model_facts.implication: Ordinary fence does not flush cache, but the observer cannot represent frontend fetching ahead through a backend fence stall.

frozen_model_facts.evidence: Engine.submit separates issue/start/ready; target commands publish asynchronous readiness and independent resource reservations. Fetch events can overlap prior target work unless dependencies/barriers prevent it.
frozen_model_facts.source: pinned engine.hpp::Engine::submit and target command dispatch
frozen_model_facts.implication: It would be false to claim every I-cache fill is globally serialized against all accelerator work. Missing independent frontend execution is the narrower supported finding.

known_missing_mechanisms: Independent fetch queue and speculative/fallthrough PC stream.
Cache refill initiation/ready history before committed consumers, including while backend waits at ordinary fences.
Physical frontend stalls/refills/branch recovery observation; current CPU taken/not-taken pricing is not that state machine.
causal_limit: These omissions are established by exact selected RTL versus frozen observer. Their actual contribution to the first-use53cycle residual is unmeasured. Do not subtract51cycles, change cache/queue prices, or qualify the model from this audit.
next_design_boundary: A future frontend abstraction would need selected fetch width/queue/redirect/refill rules and independent fetch timing, with explicit unsupported prediction states. It must preserve actual instruction/target dependency and fence semantics. This report proposes no code change, simulation, retuning, or weakened acceptance.
